content.short: Tether issues USDT, the most widely used stablecoin, and XAUt, a token backed by physical gold.
content.description: Tether is the company behind USDT, the most widely adopted stablecoin, and Tether Gold (XAUt), a token backed by physical gold. Its tokens are used for trading, payments and savings across many blockchains. Plasma was built as a stablecoin chain centred on USDT, and Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Tether's wallet and Tether Gold.
content.meta: Tether issues USDT, the largest stablecoin, and gold-backed XAUt, both listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
